```python
import cyhole

# Initialize Birdeye interaction
birdeye = cyhole.Birdeye()

# Solana token address (e.g., USDC on Solana)
token_address = "EPjFWaJB6jKhKs9dFQaVo9qxXMJbKnNGsFHV3VzGFvjc"

# Fetch token price synchronously
price_data = birdeye.get_token_price(token_address)

print(f"Token: {price_data.get('address')}")
print(f"Price: ${price_data.get('price')}")
```
